desc:
School’s out... or is it? You just got stuck in the craziest high school ever—detention lasers, exploding lockers, evil teachers, and way too much homework!
Can you dodge the chaos and make it to freedom before the bell rings?
🏫 20+ wild stages
📚 Classroom parkour
🧠 Quiz traps & locker puzzles
Time to ESCAPE or get stuck in summer school forever!
